sentences.text: Somnath Sarkar vs Unknown on 13 September, 2017

Bench: Joymalya Bagchi
 1
13.09.2017
.
as C.R.R. 3039 of 2017
In Re: An application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

In the matter of : Somnath Sarkar. ... Petitioner.
Mr. Milon Mukherjee, Mr. Biswajit Manna.
...For the Petitioner.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the registration of the criminal case under the provisions of the Indian Penal Code is unwarranted in view of the special statute, namely, Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the rules framed thereunder.
It is further submitted that the sample of adulterated food was not seized from the possession of the petitioner.
Mr. Basu, learned Government Advocate, who ordinarily appears for the State, is requested to appear in the instant case for the State.
A copy of the revision petition is handed over to Mr. Basu in Court today.
Mr. Basu is also directed to produce the Case Diary on the next date of hearing.
Let this matter appear under the heading 'Motion Adjourned' one week after Puja Vacation.

There shall be stay of the further proceeding in G.R. Case No.1010 of 2017 arising out of Santipur Police Station Case No.224 of 2017 dated 25.05.2017 under Sections 272/273/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ranaght for a period of two weeks after Puja Vacation or until further order, whichever is earlier so far as the petitioner is concerned.
